Elara's heart quickened. "Who found her?"

"Mrs. Thompson, the old lady next door. She was out walking her dog when she spotted the poor woman," Thomas replied, shaking his head. "They say she's been dead for days. Poor soul."

Elara's instincts kicked in. "Show me where it happened."
